name: Active straight leg raise
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight and your arms by your sides.
Keep the other leg pressed flat on the floor with its toes pointing up.
Pull the toes of the test leg toward you and lift it as high as you can using only your own muscles, with the knee locked.
Hold the top for 2 seconds while a partner or a phone inclinometer on your shin reads the angle between the leg and the floor (vertical is 90).
Do not use your hands or let the other leg lift or bend.
